concept: Loyalty to a friend vs. loyalty to what's right, when they conflict
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: A friend asks the student to cover for them in a situation that feels genuinely wrong, with real social stakes either way
exercise.branching_choice: Student navigates the conversation with the friend in a simulated exchange
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up exploring what loyalty means when it conflicts with honesty

assessment.success_marker: student can articulate the tension itself, not just pick a side, showing they understand both pulls
